name: genudo
description: Connect Claude to your Genudo workspace: audit operations, analyze agent performance, and build sales pipelines.
long_description: Genudo MCP gives Claude control and analytics over your Genudo workspace — AI pipelines, stages, actions/webhooks, variables, contacts, opportunities, and messages. Ask Claude to audit your AI business operations, diagnose agent performance and cost, or create and improve sales pipelines end to end.
